latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Mediaio Auto Subtitle Generator.
- Lets you upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and auto-generate embedded subtitles in minutes using a cloud-based backend.
- Supports session-based editing with export to 1080p MP4.
- Handles user prompts for uploading, editing, checking credits, viewing status, and exporting with clear feedback.
- Automatic environment setup, including token management and API authentication.
- Error handling and user guidance for file type, size, credits, and rate limits included.
